body:
Maya: paging: Halcyon reporting increased 5xxs for their EU region traffic, customer is in VPC-tenant dedicated pool. alert from synthetic checks ~07:12 UTC. tagging SRE oncall.
IncidentBot: "pager: oncall_maya paged for alert HALCYON-EU-5xx (sev2)" :rotating_light:
Maya: I'm on it, initiating bridge in #incident-bridge-halcyon. Lina, can you confirm customer impact and whether they've opened a support ticket?
Lina: Halcyon SN#7321 opened at 07:15 UTC, they report user requests timing out and chat sessions failing to init. They also pasted this error from their logs: `500 Internal: kj/kv-cache-miss`
Alex (cust-succ): I've pinged the Halcyon engineering lead for any config changes — they say no deployments from their side in last 24h. They see traffic still hitting eu1 edge, some requests fail after 3s.
Raj (sre): Quick health check: dedicated pool eu-west-2 warm nodes show high CPU on instance group halcyon-pool-3, memory OK. KV cache eviction spikes. Could be a hot prefix or cache thrash causing backend timeouts.
Maya: Plan: 1) Move Halcyon traffic off eu1 to warm standby eu2 progressively (canary at ~1%). 2) Lower DNS TTL on their external CNAME to 60s (if not already). 3) Prep warm capacity in eu2 and enable fast routing.
Nora (netops): DNS TTL currently 300s for halcyon.customer.redwood.example -> edge-eu1.redwood.example. I can push TTL change but need approval from Halcyon for route switchover window. Also confirming our DNS provider supports sub-60 updates (it does).
Tom (solutions): Recommend we also prepare a direct IP route fallback for <redacted> if CNAME propagation lags — keep as manual last-resort. I'll draft the customer comms for a 30-min maintenance window and the canary procedure.
Maya: Changing TTL to 60s now for their external record. Nora, can you confirm when change has propagated?
Nora: Done — change submitted to DNS provider at 07:24 UTC. Propagation check: `dig halcyon.customer.redwood.example @8.8.8.8` now returns TTL=60 from multiple resolvers.
DeployBot: Canary routing job started for halcyon -> eu2-warm at 07:28 UTC, traffic shift policy: linear 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 20m with automated rollback on error rate >2x baseline.
Maya: I'm initiating canary at 07:30 UTC. Raj, watch pool metrics and error rates on halcyon-eu2-warm. Lina, keep customer updated every 10 minutes.
Raj: Canary at 1% shows initial success, error rate unchanged. Monitoring KV cache hit ratio on eu2-warm: currently 87% (baseline 90%). Slightly lower but stable.
Lina: Updated Halcyon: "We have moved 1% of your traffic to an isolated warm pool in another region to check traffic health. No user-facing change expected. We'll update again in 10m"
Maya: Proceeding to 5% at 07:36 UTC.
Raj: At 5% we see error rate drop in eu1 by ~30% and eu2 holding stable. However, eu2 latency tail at p95 increased from 120ms -> 220ms. Looking into KV warm cache priming.
Nora: Noted some backend routing asymmetry; BGP path from our eu2 egress to halcyon tenant VPC shows occasional flaps correlated with p95 spikes. Opening ticket with transit provider.
Tom: Drafting comms to include that we're shifting traffic gradually and we've engaged network vendor.
Maya: Tactical change: enable prefix pre-warm on eu2 pool (increase KV prefetch warmup threads). Raj, please run the prewarm script on halcyon-pool-eu2: `./scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --tenant halcyon --target 95` and confirm.
Raj: Running now. Output snippet: ```
prewarm: discovered 42k keys
prefetching batches: 0/421
prefetch done, estimated warm hit ratio 93% after completion
```
Raj: Prewarm complete at 07:45 UTC. KV hit ratio improved to 92%. p95 latency down to 150ms in eu2. Proceed with next stage?
Maya: Move to 20% at 07:46 UTC.
DeployBot: Traffic shift at 07:46 -> 20% applied.
Raj: With 20% we see overall customer error rate fall to near baseline, eu1 errors continuing to decrease. No increases in server-side timeouts.
Lina: Halcyon updated: "We've routed more traffic to standby region; errors are decreasing. We're keeping monitoring and will reach out if anything else." They asked for ETA to complete full cutover.
Tom: ETA: if steady, complete cutover in ~15-20 minutes after the 20% step.
Nora: Transit provider acknowledged BGP flap ticket; they see a microburst at 07:42—packet loss ~0.5% for 30s, which correlates to the p95 spike earlier. They will continue monitoring.
Maya: Proceed to 100% once p95 <200ms and error rate stable for 5m. Raj, keep an eye on memory/CPU for eu2 pool and autoscaler thresholds.
Raj: Autoscaler increased instance count by 2 in halcyon-pool-eu2 at 07:50 UTC, CPU normalized. No process restarts.
DeployBot: Traffic shift to 100% scheduled and ready; will execute on Maya confirmation.
Maya: Executing final cutover at 07:55 UTC. Changing authoritative CNAME mapping to edge-eu2.redwood.example and initiating drain on eu1 halcyon nodes.
Nora: Confirmed DNS change propagated; external resolvers show new CNAME chain.
Maya: Draining eu1: `./tools/drain_pool.sh --pool halcyon-pool-eu1 --grace 300`
Raj: Drain in progress, no new sessions accepted on eu1. Existing sessions allowed to finish. Error rate on customer now at normal baseline, p95 110ms.
Lina: Notified customer that full cutover is complete, asked for verification of their end-to-end tests.
Alex: Halcyon confirms their smoke tests pass and that there's no visible 500s in last 10m. They asked for a short postmortem and root cause analysis.
Maya: Brief RCA notes for follow-up: initial trigger likely KV cache hot key/eviction on eu1 dedicated pool combined with transient transit BGP microburst. Mitigation steps performed: DNS TTL reduction, staged canary to eu2 warm, KV prewarm, autoscale, drain eu1. Action items: 1) Add proactive KV prewarm during warm standby health checks, 2) Increase low-TTL support play for enterprise customers, 3) Network vendor to investigate BGP stability during peak.
Tom: I'll own the customer-facing postmortem draft and coordinate with Alex for timeline.
Maya: Thanks team. Marking incident resolved for paging at 08:05 UTC. IncidentBot: "incident HALCYON-EU-5xx marked resolved by oncall_maya at 08:05" :white_check_mark:
Lina: Closing internal bridge in 10. Will create a follow-up ticket for RCA and the action items.
Raj: Adding perf graphs to ticket and linking dumps of prewarm run.
Maya: Great work — nice and fast. :thumbsup:
